lookups_method: WebSearch (USPTO/Trademarkia/justia/uspto.report) + industry-source verification (CraftJacks 5-trademarked-list, Wine Enthusiast, Difford's, Bacardi case law). WebFetch was blocked, so direct TESS HTML retrieval was not possible; all USPTO data was extracted via WebSearch summaries.
candidate_methodology: Cross-referenced 734 titles against (a) the canonical 5 US-trademarked cocktails (Sazerac, Painkiller, Dark 'n' Stormy, Hand Grenade, Whiskarita); (b) brand-name-as-cocktail patterns (Kahlua, Tia Maria, Pimm's, Vimto, Bellini, etc.); (c) modern post-2000 branded creations (Honey Deuce, Frosé, Ranch Water, Spaghett, Whiskarita); (d) restaurant-named cocktails (Empellón); (e) celebrity-likeness names (Bob Marley).

rate_limit_issues: WebFetch tool is blocked in this environment, preventing direct TESS HTML scraping. WebSearch worked but is rate-limited; relied on Trademarkia/Justia/uspto.report search summaries. Coverage is thus indirect for non-canonical names.
